verdict.rationale: Datadog ships an official CLI, datadog-ci, documented on GitHub and named for CI use. It also has an API reference and a CI Visibility product, so it can be driven headlessly in CI pipelines for automation. The evidence is limited to titles and a probe line rather than detailed usage docs. missing for 10: detailed docs of datadog-ci commands and CI pipeline usage, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths 404), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
